metadata.title: Ramiz Ali Mohammed — Full-Stack Software Engineer | Next.js • Laravel • C#
metadata.description: Portfolio of Ramiz Ali Mohammed — a results-driven Software Engineer with 4+ years crafting scalable web platforms, enterprise systems, and production-grade APIs using Next.js, Laravel, and C#.

hero.name: Ramiz Ali
hero.title: Software Engineer
hero.tagline: I engineer the full picture — from sleek, responsive interfaces to powerful backends and APIs that scale. Every line of code I write is built to perform, built to last, and built to impress.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: Production platforms serving real users — architected, built, and deployed

items.title: Washly
items.subtitle: Multi-Vendor Laundry Platform
items.description: Architected and built from the ground up — a comprehensive multi-vendor laundry services marketplace. Engineered the full stack: secure RESTful APIs, relational database architecture, real-time order tracking, merchant management dashboards, and a seamless customer booking experience.

items.title: Makhzoon
items.subtitle: Multi-Merchant E-Commerce + POS
items.description: Engineered a complete multi-merchant e-commerce ecosystem from scratch — integrated with an in-store Point-of-Sale system featuring barcode scanning, live inventory sync across channels, multi-payment gateway processing, and automated vendor settlement workflows.

items.title: Had Delivery
items.subtitle: On-Demand Delivery Platform
items.description: Designed and built the entire backend architecture and RESTful API layer for an on-demand courier platform. Implemented real-time GPS driver tracking, intelligent order dispatching algorithms, push notifications via FCM, and high-concurrency transaction handling.

items.title: Ejar
items.subtitle: Heavy Equipment Rental Marketplace
items.description: Developed the complete frontend interface and user experience for an enterprise equipment rental marketplace — connecting contractors with heavy machinery owners through real-time availability calendars, booking workflows, and digital contract management.

items.title: Salasa Go
items.subtitle: Interactive EdTech Platform
items.description: Co-architected and developed core modules for an interactive educational platform — including student progress analytics, course management systems, automated assessment engines, and instructor dashboards with real-time engagement metrics.

items.title: Talio Live
items.subtitle: Children's Interactive Learning
items.description: Designed and implemented engaging, child-friendly UI/UX interfaces for a digital learning platform — featuring interactive animations, gamified learning paths, progress rewards, and accessibility-first responsive design for all devices.

Lead engineer driving the full product lifecycle — architecting and shipping multiple enterprise-grade platforms from zero to production. Designing scalable database schemas, building robust APIs, and delivering polished frontend experiences using Next.js, Laravel, and C#.

Delivered diverse full-stack solutions for clients across multiple industries — from e-commerce platforms and management systems to mobile app backends and RESTful API architectures. Owned the complete SDLC from requirements gathering through deployment and maintenance.

Engineered mission-critical internal systems from scratch for humanitarian operations — including archiving platforms, inventory management tools, and coordination systems. Delivered secure, reliable software under real-world operational constraints.

items.quote: Ramiz has been instrumental in engineering multiple platforms for us from the ground up — each one delivered with exceptional speed, clean architecture, and production-grade reliability. His mastery of Laravel, Next.js, and system design consistently exceeds expectations.
items.name: Salasa Engineering Team

items.quote: The backend systems and API architectures Ramiz built for us handled real-world traffic flawlessly — fast, secure, and built to scale. His ability to own the full stack from database to deployment is truly rare.
items.name: Client Engineering Team
